newsitem.title: UK: Man Utd shares surge on European success.
newsitem.headline: Man Utd shares surge on European success.

text.p: Manchester United shares climbed towards record highs on Thursday following the English soccer club's qualification for the lucrative knock-out stages of the European Champions' League.

United shares had added 13 1/2p to 586p by 0855 GMT on the back of a 2-0 win over Rapid Vienna on Wednesday night, a victory which took United into the last eight of the competition. They now play Portuguese champions Porto over two legs in March.
United shares hit a record 590p on Wednesday before dropping back in volatile pre-match trading.
"I believe they are saying that going all the way to the European final would be worth nine million (stg)," said one analyst.
"This morning's rise has put eight million (pounds) on the market capitalisation so you can say that the potential benefits have been fully factored in,' he added.
The club now has a market valuation of some 362 million stg.
